newsitem.title: USA: Krause's names Philip Hawley Chairman/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Krause's names Philip Hawley Chairman/CEO.

text.p: Krause's Furniture Inc said on Tuesday that it has named Philip Hawley chairman and chief executive officer.
The company also said it has received $17 million in financing from new investors, including GE Capital Service of Stamford, Conn., - a General Electric Co unit - and Philip Hawley.

Hawley is the former chairman and chief executive of Los-Angeles-based Carter Hawley Hale Stores. He replaces the current Chairman, Jean Perrette, and the current Chief Executive, Thomas DeLitto. DeLitto will continue in his other position as vice chairman, the company said.

The company said the new financing consists of a combination of equity and subordinated debt, including a $10 million infusion of new capital from GE Capital comprising five million shares of common stock sold for $1 per share and $5 million of subordinated debt with a two year pay-in-kind provision.
As part of the investment, GE Capital will receive warrants to purchase 1.4 million additional shares, the company said.

The company said the financing also includes $4 million through the sale of four million shares of common stock sold for $1 per share to a combination of new and existing shareholders, including Hawley, and the conversion of $3 million of existing convertible promissory notes and a demand promissory note into common stock, also for $1 per share.
